mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO growth_coach_nudge( user_id, nudge_key, nudge_type, level, title, content, route_path, status, notification_id, sent_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{nudgeKey}, #{nudgeType}, #{level}, #{title}, #{content}, #{routePath}, #{status}, NULL, NULL, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_coach_nudge SET status = 'SENT', notification_id = #{notificationId}, sent_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'
